results.title: Yung DSA—The Rising Rap Star Making His Mark In Bigg Boss 20
results.description: From winning the season's first captaincy task to bringing Pune's Desi Hip-Hop music to national television, rapper Yung DSA has emerged as one of Bigg Boss 20's most talked-about contestants.

results.title: Jaishankar says India-Bulgaria roadmap sets "very clear pathway" as EU FTA nears during talks with FM Velislava Petrova
results.description: New Delhi [India], November 21 (ANI): External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar on Saturday welcomed Bulgarian Foreign Minister Velislava Petrova to India on Saturday, saying both sides are approving a 'detailed roadmap of cooperation' while pointing to the expected rollout of the India-European Union Free Trade Agreement as a catalyst for broader engagement.
